suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Nhân sự & Tuyển dụng (HR/TA)
suggestions.reasoning: As an office receptionist with strong organizational and interpersonal skills, you possess foundational traits that align well with Human Resources. According to Stanford HAI (2024), while AI automation streamlines repetitive tasks like CV screening and calendar scheduling, final candidate engagement, empathy, and relationship building remain heavily dependent on human rapport. Your background in guest relations and scheduling directly translates to the administrative and coordination pillars of HR and internal communications.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your strengths in friendly communication, organization, and working well under high-pressure conditions match the core human elements required in HR and internal communication roles. Even though you currently have limited IT and English skills, your profile aligns with pivot paths that build upon your organizational background without requiring immediate high-tech mastery.
